description:
A crate README states the crate's purpose and when to choose it, and links to the pages that own everything else. The gf2-core, gf2-coding and gf2-algebra READMEs carry per-area capability statements that the reference and concepts pages own.

## Background

The owner decided on 2026-10-03 that every crate README holds purpose and links only. Capabilities and feature flags are owned by `docs/reference/supported-configurations.md`, `docs/concepts/` and Rustdoc.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: `crates/gf2-core/README.md`, `crates/gf2-coding/README.md` and `crates/gf2-algebra/README.md` each state the crate's purpose and when to choose it, and carry no capability list, feature table or module inventory.
- [hard] REQ-02: Each links to `docs/index.md`, to the pages that own its capabilities and feature flags, and to the crate's Rustdoc through the locally generated `target/doc/<crate>/index.html` path next to the command that builds it.
- [hard] REQ-03: Every fact removed from a README is stated on the page the README links to; no fact is lost.
- [hard] REQ-04: Each README has fewer lines after the change, and its links and commands resolve.
title: Reduce the gf2-core, gf2-coding and gf2-algebra READMEs to purpose and links
